body.statement:
If \(f(a)=f_0\), \(\theta'(a)=r_0\), and \(\kappa(a)=\kappa_0\) are positive constants on \(J\), then
\[
 \mathcal V(P)=|J|\left(\frac{f_0r_0^2}{4\kappa_0}\right)^{1/3},
 \qquad
 T_n(P)=n^{1/3}|J|\left(\frac{f_0r_0^2}{4\kappa_0}\right)^{1/3}.
\]
The spatial coordinate in \(\texttt{thm:causal-transfer}\) is affine with this image length. At any one fixed dose, translation and affine GCM equivariance reduce the canonical marginal to \(D(0)\). These identities do not imply a growing-domain excursion, observed-statistic transfer, or calibration theorem.
body.justification: Checks the constant-coefficient clock and fixed-location normalization exactly.
body.gap: The reduction supplies no growing-domain or calibration law.
body.consumer: It is a diagnostic identity only.
body.proof_tex:
Substitution of the three constant functions into \(\texttt{def:spatial-clock}\) gives
\[
 \begin{aligned}
 \mathcal V(P)
 &=\int_J\left(\frac{f_0r_0^2}{4\kappa_0}\right)^{1/3}da
 =|J|\left(\frac{f_0r_0^2}{4\kappa_0}\right)^{1/3},\\
 T_n(P)
 &=n^{1/3}\mathcal V(P)
 =n^{1/3}|J|\left(\frac{f_0r_0^2}{4\kappa_0}\right)^{1/3}.
\end{aligned}
\]
The inverse local scale from \(\texttt{thm:causal-transfer}\) is then the constant
\[
 h_n(a)^{-1}=n^{1/3}\left(\frac{f_0r_0^2}{4\kappa_0}\right)^{1/3},
\]
so its integral from \(\inf J\) to \(a\) is affine and its total image length is the displayed \(T_n(P)\). For one fixed canonical constraint point \(x\), the identity
\[
 X(x+t)-X(x)-2xt=\mathbb W_x(t)+t^2
\]
from \(\texttt{lem:canonical-wellposedness}\) translates the constraint to zero and subtracts its tangent. Affine equivariance of both GCM problems then gives \(D(x)=\Phi(\mathbb W_x)\stackrel d=D(0)\). This proves only the fixed-location identity and the constant-clock algebra.
